acceptanceCriteria: A read-only `corvint docs corpus` validate subcommand checks test-knowledge/1 input against DCP-V1-086..088 with the same refusal codes as the build, exit status and JSON pinned by a CLI test.
body: Residual of V1-1868 (PR #1165, head 4c494e642, GH #1162). Records are validated only during corpus build; adopters have no standalone command to check a test-knowledge file before building.
title: docs corpus: standalone validate command for test-knowledge/1 records
